text:
That makes sense. It's 2 AM, and you've just laid the groundwork for the whole application. The skeleton is the hardest structural part, so you're in a good spot.

When you pick it back up, a good next step is to tackle the Statement of Need and Program Design first, since they're 60% of the score. Gathering your data sources ahead of time will make drafting go faster.

Get some rest. I'm here whenever you're ready to keep going.
